items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I don't know where Penny was from, but he had been around Alexander, Louisiana playing with a band by the name of Harry Walker.

ctx.x: Where was he from? I don't know where Penny was from, but he had been around Alexander, Louisiana playing with a band by the name of Harry Walker. Because all the, all the, all the new york musicians, a lot of old new york musicians knew him. He was great, great trumpet player man. Triple tongue, everything. Reed, bass reader. Fake tooth.
But he, he got back with the Dixieland. Got perfect with the Dixieland.
